correctness.rationale: Integral cross-ratio equalizer elimination and explicit unit checks yield exactly Spec Z[u]/(u^2-u-1). The SNC boundary has no fixed point because the five-cycle acts freely on the ten components, any point meeting at most two. The discriminant five yields the characteristic-five double local point; a directly differentiated matrix has (J-I) nonzero of square zero. The formal fixed locus of J is a line while the actual locus is zero-dimensional, proving non-linearizability. Exact algebraic identities independently replay from packaged verify.py.

value.rationale: The split quintic del Pezzo and its canonical C5 action are geometrically central. The flat integral scheme isolates characteristic five as the unique fixed-point collision prime and demonstrates a genuinely nonlinear isolated wild order-five action with unipotent tangent Jordan block. This provides a structural boundary condition for future investigation of its wild quotient; it is not merely a finite count or familiar generic two-fixed-point result.
